detail.command:
set -euo pipefail
[ -z "$(git status --short)" ]
test -f App.tsx
test -f package.json
test -f src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx
test -f src/components/SectionCard.tsx
test -f src/services/index.ts
test -f src/types/market.ts
grep -q 'interface MarketAsset' src/types/market.ts
grep -q 'interface MarketQuote' src/types/market.ts
grep -q 'interface MarketRecommendation' src/types/market.ts
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(!p.scripts?.typecheck || !p.scripts?.test) process.exit(1)"
printf '%s\n' FINAL_VERIFY_OK
